items.description:
S.O.A.T (Security Operations and Tactics) is a private security company providing tailored solutions for clients operating in demanding, high-risk environments across South Africa, backed by more than ten years of experience and over 500 protected clients. Its services span close protection and executive protection, site and facility security for estates and mines, secure escort and transportation of valuable assets, and intelligence-led surveillance.

The company has completed more than 1,000 successful operations using a team of over 200 security personnel, combining national coverage with the kind of local intelligence and established networks that help reduce uncertainty for clients investing or operating in complex areas. Open 24 hours, S.O.A.T is based in Florauna, Pretoria, and suits companies needing customised security solutions for high-risk operations rather than standard guarding services.

SADT Consulting, a female-owned firm established in 2016, provides accounting, taxation and auditing services to government and private sector clients from Doringkloof, Centurion. Its offering spans audits and independent reviews, taxation and debt, financial accounting, advisory and consulting, payroll and HR services, and CIDB and COID logs.

The firm also handles family and business trust matters, and has built a track record spanning small and medium enterprises through to macro market companies and high-level government departments, drawing on an unlimited network across Africa and the globe to tailor solutions to each client's financial requirements. Based in Doringkloof, Centurion, SADT Consulting suits businesses of any size needing accounting, tax or audit services from a firm with both local and continental reach.

Sequal Suppliers, established in 2009 in Bronberrik, Centurion, distributes safety equipment and disposable protective wear for the industrial and packaging industry, drawing on a collective product, market and industry knowledge of around 25 years. The business has built relationships ranging from packaging companies within South Africa to mines in the DRC, positioning itself as a complete supply chain management partner rather than a single-product supplier.

Its ongoing technical after-sales backup service is something customers in an otherwise technically under-served market have come to rely on, supported by what the company describes as a genuine going-the-extra-mile attitude. Based in Bronberrik, Centurion, Sequal Suppliers suits packaging companies and mining operations across South Africa and the DRC needing safety equipment and disposable protective wear backed by real technical support.

Stafix - Electric Fence & Security Centre, trading under Ndlovu Fencing (Pty) Ltd, is the Southern African distributor of the international STAFIX and JVA ranges of electric fence energizers, serving the Agricultural, Wildlife and Perimeter Security markets. The company's founder introduced high-powered electric fencing to the Southern African market in the 1970s, and the business now operates 25 branches across the region, each with its own in-house technical personnel for fast after-sales repair.

Beyond energizers, Stafix supplies CCTV, alarm systems, electric locks, perimeter mesh and taut-wire fencing, and gate automation, backed by an extensive network of accredited Stafix installers and its own accredited electric-fence and CCTV training courses. Based in Kloofsig, Centurion, Stafix suits farms, game reserves and security-conscious property owners needing electric fencing and related security equipment installed by accredited specialists.

Stratus Technologies, Inc. Africa, based at Lynnwood Bridge, is the South African office of a global technology provider with more than 25 years of experience designing, building, deploying and managing complex computing infrastructure, including its ztC Endurance and ztC Edge platforms and everRun software built for continuous availability in mission-critical applications. As part of the wider Penguin Solutions group, the company has grown into an NVIDIA AI Factory Specialized Partner, having deployed and managed more than 99,000 GPUs globally.

That combination of fault-tolerant computing heritage and AI infrastructure expertise lets the business support clients needing systems that simply cannot go down, alongside newer large-scale AI deployment work. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Stratus Technologies suits businesses running mission-critical applications as much as those scaling AI infrastructure.

T C B Machine Moving & Rigging, established in 1990 and operating across the Gauteng region, specialises in heavy-lifting, machine moving and factory relocation, built on more than 35 years of rigging expertise. Its fleet of crane trucks and specialised lifting equipment is carefully matched to each job, whether that means relocating a small factory or moving heavy machinery such as transformers and presses.

The company backs its work with a 100% satisfaction guarantee and after-hour emergency support, and its crews and operators are highly skilled and certified, working alongside equipment that is itself certified and well maintained. Based near Wonderboom, Pretoria, T C B Machine Moving & Rigging suits manufacturers needing a factory relocated or heavy equipment moved safely and on schedule.

T-Mac Projects, based in Klerksoord, Pretoria, specialises in alternative building methods including wendy houses, Nutec fibre-cement structures and timber log homes, built to a custom design where required. The company aims to complete these alternative builds faster and more affordably than traditional brick-and-mortar construction, without sacrificing the quality of the finished structure.

Beyond new builds, T-Mac Projects also handles installation and repairs for existing wendy houses, Nutec structures and log homes, giving clients a single contractor across the lifetime of a structure rather than needing to find someone new for repair work. Based in Klerksoord, Pretoria, T-Mac Projects suits homeowners wanting a quick, affordable additional structure such as a home office, granny flat or garden room.

The 13th Check Business Services provides outsourced payroll administration on a weekly, fortnightly or monthly basis, covering leave management, employee payslips, salary package structures and monthly payroll reporting. Its employee self-service option lets staff access their own payroll information directly, reducing the back-and-forth that payroll queries usually generate for an HR team.

The business also handles statutory monthly, bi-annual and annual return submissions and IRP5/IT3 certificates, alongside broader HR services such as employment equity planning and policy development. Working from offices in Centurion and Cape Town, The 13th Check Business Services suits businesses wanting payroll processed accurately and on time every time, freeing owners and HR staff to focus on running the business rather than administration.

The garden group, with more than 37 years of experience in garden design, landscaping and landscape maintenance, is an award-winning company serving prestigious residential estates, complexes and corporate clients including hotels, restaurants, shopping centres, hospitals, schools and universities. Its work has been recognised with SALI Awards, reflecting a focus on transforming outdoor spaces into landscapes that uphold high environmental standards.

The business specialises in designing and maintaining wildlife estates using native and non-invasive plant species that foster local biodiversity, alongside advanced invasive plant control to keep gardens healthy and free of harmful species. Open Monday to Friday from 7am to 4pm, The garden group is based in Salieshoek, Silverton, and suits golf estates, office parks and residential clients wanting water-wise, indigenous landscaping maintained by an award-winning team.

The Pretoria Treefelling Guru & Emergency Tree Service 24/7 is a fully qualified and accredited tree felling business with ten years of experience serving Pretoria and Centurion, offering tree felling, tree stump removal and grinding, tree trimming and pruning, and palm tree cleaning and removal. Its storm-damaged tree removal service and dedicated emergency tree felling lines for Pretoria, Pretoria East and Centurion are available around the clock for trees that have become hazards.

Beyond tree work, the business handles site and plot clearing, rubble removal across Centurion, Pretoria, Pretoria East and Pretoria North and Montana, and instant lawn installation for properties wanting a finished look straight after clearance. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, The Pretoria Treefelling Guru suits homeowners needing routine tree maintenance as much as those facing a storm-damaged tree needing urgent removal.

Think Smart Built-In Systems, a South African specialist in premium central vacuum systems with more than 20 years in the industry, supplies and installs systems for new and existing homes, townhouses, apartments, offices and commercial buildings. Its range includes Canadian-made Drainvac wet-and-dry systems, which handle both dry dirt and liquid spills, and Hayden Super Vac systems known for durability and powerful performance in premium homes.

Central vacuum systems operate with the power unit installed remotely, giving extremely quiet operation and superior suction compared with a portable vacuum, while improving indoor air quality for allergy and asthma sufferers. Based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, Think Smart Built-In Systems suits homeowners, architects and builders wanting a central vacuum system supplied and professionally installed rather than relying on a portable unit.

Unique Flooring, trading from Centurion Crescent Shopping Centre since 1997, supplies and installs laminate, vinyl and engineered wood flooring plus wall cladding, backed by a five-year workmanship warranty on installations. What started as a small flooring outlet has grown into a full importer and distributor, letting the business supply products at more affordable prices than a retailer buying through a middleman.

The company has also expanded into composite decking, installed with a guarantee and priced per square metre, giving outdoor spaces the same attention to detail as an indoor flooring project. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, Unique Flooring suits homeowners wanting indoor flooring and outdoor decking sourced and installed by the same long-established supplier.

Varsity Lodge, also known as Lynnwood Varsity Lodge, offers secure, luxurious student accommodation about 250 metres from the University of Pretoria, comprising 92 units of five, six or seven bedrooms each sharing a lounge, dining room and kitchen. Residents have access to secure basement parking and on-site laundry facilities, alongside wireless internet throughout the property.

That combination of proximity to campus and shared communal living suits students wanting their own bedroom within a larger household rather than a fully self-contained flat. Based in Brooklyn, Pretoria, Varsity Lodge suits University of Pretoria students needing secure, walkable accommodation with built-in parking and laundry rather than renting privately further from campus.

VBKOM is a mining and geological consulting engineering firm offering expert mining, geological, metallurgical and industrial engineering consulting across Africa, Canada and Australia, positioning itself as a strategic partner from exploration through to production. Its technical delivery covers geological consulting, mining engineering and metallurgical engineering, the core disciplines a mining project needs from early-stage resource definition onward.

The firm also provides mineral-resource estimation, financial modelling and risk management, giving mining clients both the technical and financial analysis needed to support a project through its full lifecycle. Based in Centurion Golf Estate, VBKOM suits mining companies needing geological, engineering and financial expertise from one consultancy rather than separate specialists for each discipline.

Vertex Automation is an industrial automation integrator designing, fabricating and integrating conveyor systems, industrial robotics and complete production line systems for manufacturers across South Africa. Its custom conveyor systems are built for efficient material handling, packaging and production flow, while its Fanuc robotic systems handle pick-and-place and palletising tasks across manufacturing, automotive, food and beverage, packaging and pharmaceutical operations.

Projects range from standalone machines to fully integrated production lines, with the company's mechanical, software and electrical design teams working alongside fabrication and installation crews to deliver systems covering PLC, HMI and control-system integration. Based in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, Vertex Automation suits factories wanting to reduce manual processes and improve production efficiency through a single automation partner.

YoungByte, based in Theresapark, is a technology consultancy with more than 14 years in operation, offering systems modernisation consulting alongside its own skills academy for upskilling clients' teams. Its software platforms cover specific niches including school management, savings group administration and church administration, built for organisations that would otherwise run these functions on spreadsheets or paper.

The business also provides digital presence services, including web design and social media management, for clients wanting an online presence alongside their core software needs. Based in Theresapark, Pretoria, YoungByte suits schools, savings groups, churches and other organisations needing purpose-built software rather than a generic off-the-shelf system.

Accolade Consulting, a Level 2 BBBEE-rated IT services company with 23 years of creating trusted partnerships with clients, draws on more than 200 years of combined expert experience across its skilled employees. Its Microsoft-focused services cover Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Apps and Power Automate development, Microsoft Server support and implementation, and SQL Server database administration and development.

Beyond Microsoft products, the company offers custom application development, ODEX and Talend data integration, RFID devices and tagging, and security systems including CCTV with network integration and offsite monitoring, alongside physical network design, implementation and upgrades. Based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, Accolade Consulting suits businesses wanting Microsoft infrastructure, custom software and physical security systems managed by one long-established IT partner.

ANEW Hotels & Resorts Head Office and Central Reservations is the corporate head office and central booking centre for the ANEW Hotels & Resorts group, based at the ANEW Hotel Centurion Pretoria property on the corner of Gordon Hood Road and Hendrik Verwoerd Drive. From this office the group coordinates bookings across its hotels and resorts spanning Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Mpumalanga, the North West Province and the Western Cape.

The group's portfolio ranges from city hotels such as ANEW Hotel Capital Pretoria and ANEW Hotel Hatfield to resort properties including ANEW Resort Hazyview and ANEW Resort Wilderness on the Garden Route, giving central reservations staff a wide spread of properties to coordinate bookings and meetings and events enquiries across. Based in Centurion Golf Estate, ANEW Hotels & Resorts Head Office and Central Reservations suits corporate travel bookers and event planners needing one point of contact across the group's national portfolio.

ANH Technologies, based in Koedoespoort, is a leading importer and distributor of advanced renewable energy solutions, supplying high-quality solar and battery storage products to installers, resellers and industry professionals across Africa. The company is the appointed South African importer and distributor for brands including SMA, BYD and Renusol, alongside Phocos, Intilion and Hoppecke battery and charge-control equipment.

Its range covers mounting systems, motive power and rail power equipment, and reserve power solutions such as the SMA Sunny Island system, giving installers a single wholesale source across several major international renewable energy brands. Based in Koedoespoort, Pretoria, ANH Technologies suits solar installers and wholesalers needing established international battery and inverter brands rather than sourcing each brand separately.

AO Group, founded in South Africa in 2016 and Level 1 BEE-rated, brings together more than 60 specialists across software engineering, managed ICT, cybersecurity, digital marketing, AI and business advisory services, delivered through divisions including AO Software, AO ICT, AO Digital, AO Connect and AO Consult. The group has offices across seven countries, including Kenya, Botswana, Zambia and Mauritius alongside its Lynnwood Glen base, and has delivered more than 100 projects for clients in banking, mobility, retail, agriculture and telecommunications.

Security and compliance are built into its delivery model from design through operation, with the company working to POPIA, GDPR, DORA-readiness and OWASP-aligned standards across its cloud-native, API-led projects. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, AO Group suits organisations wanting one accountable technology partner across software, IT, cybersecurity and AI rather than several separate vendors.

Ashton Group traces back to 2000, when its founders were instrumental in establishing the Ashton brand and incorporating the Robberts Marais Chartered Accountants practice, later formalising as the Ashton CA (SA) Group to concentrate on financial, accounting, taxation and auditing services for predominantly privately owned, owner-driven businesses. The firm has since grown into a well-established entity servicing a vast array of clients throughout South Africa, with a staff of about 20.

Clients have praised the firm for delivering a professional, timely and practical service they can rely on, alongside the depth of expertise each team member brings across fields such as retirement planning, tax and financial statements. Based in Ashley Gardens, Pretoria, Ashton Group suits privately owned businesses wanting personal attention from an established accounting and auditing firm rather than a large impersonal practice.

items.reason: Astron Energy's own website is pure brand-wide rebrand marketing (UCount Rewards, FreshStop, Seattle, FleetCard) with no facts specific to this Eldoraigne forecourt; the current description is itself near-identical templated chain text used across every Astron Energy branch, which the chain-business rule requires branch-specific facts to avoid.

items.description:
ATC Innovations, delivering turnkey automation since 2009, designs and builds complete automation and machine-building solutions for the industrial and automotive sectors from a 3,000 square metre mechanical, electrical and machine-building facility in Rosslyn. Its in-house engineering, manufacturing and assembly teams work under one roof, with a strong focus on materials-handling systems ranging from simple standalone units to large integrated production systems.

Each project is supported by dedicated mechanical, software and electrical design teams working alongside fabrication and installation crews, backed by full metal fabrication capability, a CNC machine shop and dedicated electrical and control panel manufacturing. The company reports that automation investment typically returns on investment within three to five years, with up to 95% less downtime than manual processes. Based in Akasia, Pretoria, ATC Innovations suits automotive and industrial manufacturers wanting a single partner from concept through installed, working automation.

Bigradap Group Technologies, a member of the Bigradap Group, provides businesses across Africa's private and public sectors with a wide range of IT solutions built around its Multi-Sectoral Integrated Management Systems (SIM/MIMS) platform, covering development, supply, implementation and maintenance. Its ICT support services run across the full technology life cycle, from acquisition through to the maintenance and improvement of information and communications technology infrastructure.

The company's offering extends to security, capacity planning, and business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing, helping clients keep critical systems running through a disruption rather than only after the fact. With a branch in the Democratic Republic of Congo alongside its Highveld Techno Park base, Bigradap Group Technologies suits public and private sector clients across Africa needing ICT infrastructure design, implementation and ongoing resilience planning from one provider.

Blackboard Business Intelligence specialises in business and data analytics, delivering business intelligence solutions globally across the mining, retail, oil and gas, insurance, utilities and banking sectors. The company is a global partner of Hitachi Energy, previously ABB Power Grids, and Mincom, and supports a wide range of platforms rather than favouring one vendor, including SAP Business Objects, SAP BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, Microsoft Power BI, Oracle and Tibco Jaspersoft.

Its Cloud Optimisation practice helps clients save cost, optimise processes, and ingest and integrate data more intelligently, while embedding the policies, procedures, monitoring and reporting needed for governance, risk and compliance. Based in Weavind Park, Pretoria, Blackboard Business Intelligence suits organisations needing data-driven consulting across multiple BI platforms rather than being locked into a single vendor's toolset.

Bothongo Group Management provides property management services at Bothongo Plaza West, a 17-storey office building at 271 Francis Baard Street, Pretoria, on behalf of the wider Bothongo Group. The group itself develops commercial and residential property across South Africa, giving the management arm access to development expertise beyond day-to-day building operations.

Beyond property, Bothongo Group operates subsidiaries spanning hospitality, agriculture, IT, construction and aviation, reflecting a diversified group structure rather than a single-sector property company. Based in Midfields Estate, Pretoria, Bothongo Group Management suits tenants and property owners wanting a building managed by a team backed by a wider, diversified property and investment group.

Bridal Wardrobe was an upmarket bridal boutique at Lynnwood Bridge, known as the leading stockist of the full Enzoani wedding gown collection in Africa, alongside Elysee and Pen.Liv gowns and accessories. Operating two upmarket bridal stores, in Pretoria and Johannesburg, the business built a reputation on wedding gowns of exceptional quality, detail and fit over roughly 12 years at its Lynnwood Bridge location.

After that period at Lynnwood Bridge, Bridal Wardrobe relocated to a new boutique in Menlo Park in 2025, continuing its focus on sale and hire of designer wedding gowns rather than off-the-rack options. Based in Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria, Bridal Wardrobe suited brides wanting access to the full Enzoani range alongside Elysee and Pen.Liv gowns under one roof.

Busines Academy Southern Africa (BASA), one of the oldest and most trusted training firms in Africa, has developed human capital for clients large and small, private and public, since 2011 across management and technical fields including HR, accounting, IT security, project management and supply chain management. Its course formats span public short courses, certified professional programmes, in-house training delivered at a client's own premises, and online eLearning for organisations wanting flexible, self-paced study.

Sample courses include a Certificate in Maintenance Management covering planning, scheduling, cost control and asset lifecycle planning, a Certified Human Resources Professional programme, and a Certificate in Advanced Project Management. Based in Bryntirion, Pretoria, BASA suits organisations across Africa wanting accredited, flexible training delivered in the format that suits their team.

Bvumbi Ready Mix, founded in 2019, is a black-owned, youth-led company delivering ready-mix concrete across South Africa from grades of 10 MPa up to 60 MPa, tailored to the specifications of builders, engineers, developers and architects. Its state-of-the-art technology and commitment to meeting each customer's specifications underpin a mission that extends beyond concrete supply to job creation and community empowerment.

The company's concrete pumping service uses both mobile and stationary pumps for efficient placement on large-scale projects or hard-to-reach sites, and it offers a free site inspection covering concrete choices, volume calculations and delivery access at no cost to the client. Based at its Hazeldean head office, Bvumbi Ready Mix suits builders and developers needing concrete supplied, pumped and advised on by one youth-led company.

Caddie Software's South African office, based in Highveld, Centurion, sells and supports the Caddie Professional CAD software suite, covering 2D and 3D CAD applications for architecture, civil and structural engineering, surveying, digital terrain modelling and photorealistic rendering. The suite gives built-environment professionals a single CAD platform across several disciplines rather than separate software for each.

Alongside sales and support, the office runs a local training centre, helping new and existing users get the most out of the software's features rather than learning them unassisted. Based in Centurion Golf Estate, Caddie Software suits architects, engineers and surveyors wanting CAD software, local support and training from the same provider.

Car Service City - Montana, a branch of the Car Service City vehicle repair chain with its own dedicated branch contact point, offers major and minor services, repairs and replacements, and genuine parts for all makes and models. The branch includes a complimentary 62-point safety inspection with every service, giving customers a documented check of their vehicle's condition alongside the work carried out.

The branch is RMI and MIWA accredited, and customers can pay through options including Mobicred and MoreTyme, or earn Standard Bank UCount Rewards on their service. Open Monday to Friday from 7am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, Car Service City - Montana is based in Montana Gardens, Pretoria, and suits motorists wanting accredited servicing and repairs backed by a documented safety inspection.

Cardiff Capital, a registered financial services provider and life insurance broker house operating since 2005, specialises in life, disability, income protection and severe illness cover for individuals and groups, including the employees of small to medium-sized companies. Its advisers also manage short- and long-term investments, pension and medical fund arrangements for both individuals and groups, bringing retirement and investment planning together with core risk cover.

A separate short-term insurance division offers comprehensive cover for personal and commercial clients, extending the practice beyond life and investment products alone. Open Monday to Saturday from 8am to 7pm, Cardiff Capital is based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, and suits individuals and small businesses wanting risk cover, investment planning and short-term insurance handled by one broker house.

CEC, also known as Centurion Enquiry Chambers, is a meeting venue in Lyttletown Office Park purpose-built for insolvency inquiries and business rescue meetings, a specific niche most generic function venues are not set up for. Its facilities include boardroom seating, recording equipment and free WiFi, with catering available on request for longer sessions.

The venue's main room, the Bench Chamber, seats up to 30 people, giving it enough capacity for a formal inquiry with legal representatives, creditors and other stakeholders present. Based in Centurion Central, CEC suits insolvency practitioners, business rescue practitioners and legal teams needing a dedicated, properly equipped venue for a formal inquiry rather than adapting an ordinary meeting room.

ClickOn Communications, trusted across South Africa by more than 1 million daily users across over 500 estates for more than 20 years, is an estate management and security software company used by managers and security teams at residential estates and gated communities. Its platform combines hardware, software, a mobile app and cloud infrastructure into one integrated system, replacing manual logbooks and gate bottlenecks with automatic verification and seamless entry.

AI-powered facial recognition, licence-plate scanning and biometric verification eliminate manual processes at the gate while improving security accuracy, and the cloud-based ecosystem gives real-time data synchronisation across every touchpoint, backed by POPIA-compliant data handling. Based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, ClickOn Communications suits estate managers and HOAs wanting visitor, contractor and resident access managed through one unified, auditable platform.

Company @ The Ready, based in Lynnwood Glen, is a business registration and compliance consultancy offering new company registration alongside income tax registration certificates, Tax Compliance Status (PIN) applications and B-BBEE verification affidavits. Its services extend to share certificates, combined company registers, and the COIDA and UIF registrations a business needs once it starts employing staff.

The firm also explains and manages the ongoing compliance obligations that follow registration, including VAT registration thresholds and the consequences of missing CIPC annual fee payments, which can lead to deregistration if left unresolved. Partnering with an audit firm for bookkeeping and tender preparation, Company @ The Ready suits new and growing businesses wanting registration and the compliance obligations that follow handled by one consultancy.

Compressor Mart, based off the N4 highway at Mooiplaats in Pretoria East, sells new and second-hand air compressors ranging from small workshop units to heavy-duty industrial systems, backed by a three-month to one-year warranty. Its team takes time to understand a customer's specific application before recommending equipment, whether that's powering pneumatic tools, running an assembly line, or supplying medical-grade air for a hospital or dental practice.

Beyond sales, the company provides regular servicing, including routine inspections, filter replacements and performance checks, and repairs equipment quickly to minimise downtime when a compressor breaks down. Based in Donkerhoek, Pretoria East, Compressor Mart suits industries from pharmaceutical manufacturing to refinery and drilling operations needing compressors supplied, serviced and repaired by specialists in air and gas compression.

CompuPort, based in Queenswood, is a computer consultancy providing IT support and maintenance, network and server design and installation, and computer hardware for businesses and home users. Its backup and data security solutions help clients protect data against loss, while its UPS power solutions keep systems running through a power interruption rather than shutting down abruptly.

Beyond core IT services, the business also offers printing, copying and vehicle licence renewal services from its Queenswood premises, giving local customers a reason to visit for errands beyond computer support alone. Based in Queenswood, Pretoria, CompuPort suits home users and small businesses wanting IT support and everyday services handled at one neighbourhood shop.

COPS Tactical Reaction Services, part of the Sure Guard Security group, is an armed response and security company based in Laudium, Centurion, providing trained security officers and armed response for homes and businesses in the area. Its tactical support unit backs up standard patrol and response work for incidents requiring a more coordinated reaction.

Operations are monitored from a 24-hour control room, giving the company oversight of its officers and response vehicles around the clock rather than only during business hours. Based in Laudium, Centurion, COPS Tactical Reaction Services suits residents and businesses wanting armed response backed by a tactical unit and round-the-clock monitoring from an established security group.

CoreMet Mineral Processing, based in The Willows, offers dry and wet mineral processing technology across a wide range of commodities, including heavy minerals, gold, platinum-group metals, diamonds, coal, powder minerals, food and pharmaceuticals. Its niche product portfolio centres on Kroosh Screens in the X-Line range, Virto Screens in the C-Line and T-Line ranges, and its own Multi Gravity Separator line, including the C902 production unit and the C900 pilot-plant version used to test a process before committing to full-scale equipment.

Beyond equipment, the company offers metallurgical ore characterisation, test programme design and execution, process technology selection, and equipment performance testing, modelling and optimisation. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, CoreMet Mineral Processing suits mining and processing operations needing both separation equipment and the metallurgical testing to specify it correctly.

Corporate Coffee Solutions, with a Pretoria branch in Magalieskruin, supplies bean-to-cup, espresso, filter and capsule coffee machines on rental, lease or purchase terms, serving businesses across South Africa and Namibia. Alongside the machines themselves, the company supplies freshly roasted coffee, keeping customers stocked without needing a separate coffee supplier.

Its barista training helps office staff get the most out of an espresso machine rather than producing inconsistent results, and its technical support team keeps machines running once installed. Based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, Corporate Coffee Solutions suits offices wanting a coffee machine, the beans to go with it, and ongoing technical support from a single supplier.

Cosave PowerBuild & Wholesalers, an owner-managed DIY and hardware store in Kirkney, stocks everything needed to build, repair and improve a home across departments including tools and hardware, electrical and lighting, garden and outdoor, plumbing and bathrooms, and paint, waterproofing and sealants. Its range runs to hundreds of individual lines, from hand tools and power tools through to cables, switches and lighting fixtures, including products under the INGCO brand.

The store also stocks safety and workwear, automotive accessories and solar power products, rounding out its range beyond core building materials. The business states on its website that it is open 363 days a year, giving customers near year-round access to supplies. Based in Kirkney, Pretoria, Cosave PowerBuild & Wholesalers suits DIY customers and tradespeople wanting a broad hardware range available almost every day of the year.

Creatv Studio, operating as part of 5thGen Studios and headquartered in Gqeberha, is a strategic communications, ICT and digital media agency with offices across the Eastern Cape, Western Cape and Gauteng serving government, higher education, private enterprises, NGOs and individual clients. Its integrated divisions cover Creative Studio for digital marketing, branding and design, Creatv.Photography for visual storytelling, Voxaire.Africa for audiovisual and ICT solutions, and Creatv.Cloud for hosting, connectivity and disaster recovery.

The Creatv.Cloud division backs client systems with 24/7 managed support and multi-cloud experience across Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, giving clients enterprise-grade hosting alongside the agency's creative and ICT work. Based in Thatchfield Estate, Centurion, Creatv Studio suits organisations wanting branding, digital media and managed cloud hosting from one agency rather than separate suppliers for each.

Drive Dynamics, established in 2002 and based in Hennopspark, is an electrical, control and instrumentation engineering company serving agricultural, governmental, commercial, industrial and mining clients across Africa. As a leading supplier of variable speed drives, solar VSDs, solar home inverters and solar panels, the business pairs product supply with outstanding technical support and backup rather than selling equipment alone.

Its control devices range covers VSD controllers, pressure and pump controllers, HMI and PLC systems, and SMS-based controllers, alongside soft starters, electric motors, panel fans and custom electrical panel building. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, Drive Dynamics suits agricultural and industrial clients across Africa needing electrical, control and instrumentation equipment backed by genuine engineering consulting rather than a parts catalogue alone.

DST Printing, a family-owned print shop in Wierdapark with more than 16 years in the industry, treats every client like family rather than running a conventional customer base, building long-term relationships across its range of printing techniques. Its services cover embroidery, DTF (direct-to-film) printing, pad printing, heat transfers, stationery and gift printing, 3D printing and laser cutting, offered from both a physical shop and an online store.

The business says it does not rush work, instead completing orders in the shortest time that does not compromise quality, and notes that it is not impacted by loadshedding, keeping production running through power cuts. Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, DST Printing suits customers wanting a range of printing and personalisation techniques handled by one family-run shop rather than several separate specialists.

Famous Brands Coffee Company, roasting beans in South Africa since 2007 from its Hennopspark facility, is the trusted coffee supplier behind South African favourites including Mugg & Bean, Vovo Telo, Wimpy, Turn 'n Tender and Lupa Osteria. Its whole bean and ground filter blends are roasted in an FSSC 22000 food safety certified facility, using beans sourced from growing regions including Brazil, Costa Rica, Ethiopia, Guatemala and Rwanda.

The company also supplies coffee machines directly to businesses, ranging from 2- and 3-group traditional espresso machines for restaurants and cafes to single-group machines suited to a home or office. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, Famous Brands Coffee Company suits restaurants and cafes wanting the same beans and blends used by established national coffee brands.

Grace Water Solutions, headquartered in Zwavelpoort, provides industrial water treatment for potable water, automotive, food and beverage, mining, gas and bottled-water clients, built around reducing downtime, improving water quality and keeping operations compliant with industry regulations. Its SANAS-accredited laboratory services back up on-site support and custom plant designs tailored to a client's specific operational challenges.

The company also handles plant conversions and upgrades, letting existing facilities adapt to new regulations or capacity needs rather than requiring a full rebuild, alongside scheduled system maintenance that prevents costly unplanned downtime. Its operating company holds Level 2 BBBEE accreditation. Based in Zwavelpoort, Pretoria, Grace Water Solutions suits industrial and commercial operators needing water treatment designed, installed and kept compliant by one specialist provider.

HD Telecoms, headquartered in Zwartkop, Centurion, is a telecommunications and IT provider running a 3CX-based Cloud PBX voice platform with unlimited voice lines and a VoIP mobile app, serving customers with additional branches in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban. Its services cover call centre design and consultation, PBX solutions for companies of any size, and data connectivity through fibre, LTE and ADSL.

Beyond voice and connectivity, the business offers hosted PBX solutions, VoIP billing platforms, email and web hosting, Microsoft Exchange, and IT support and backup services, supplying IP phones from brands including Yealink and Fanvil. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, HD Telecoms suits businesses wanting voice, connectivity and IT support handled by one national provider rather than separate suppliers for each.

Life Eugene Marais Hospital, with 384 beds, is one of the largest hospitals in the Life Healthcare Group, situated close to Pretoria's city centre and well known for its neurosurgical and orthopaedic surgery. Its modern facilities include 14 theatres, one hybrid theatre and cathlab, specialised cardiac theatres, a neuro-spinal rehabilitation unit, and a comprehensive range of diagnostic equipment supporting both routine and more serious procedures.

The hospital's Oncology Centre offers cutting-edge cancer treatment, including the Varian TrueBeam on the Brainlab Novalis Platform, a non-invasive radiosurgery system that protects surrounding healthy tissue and accounts for patient movement to increase treatment accuracy. Based in Les Marais, Pretoria, Life Eugene Marais Hospital suits patients needing specialised neurosurgical, orthopaedic or oncology care alongside general hospital services.
